other_datasets.source: Frozen simulations created for nlrFlow teaching

soil_p_sorption.description: Frozen Langmuir phosphorus-sorption example with soil class and sample hierarchy.

sciml_teaching_datasets.source: Frozen simulations created for nlrFlow Phase E (blocks 68-74) teaching and software tests

sciml_crop_growth.purpose: Neural ODE and UDE trajectories with genotype and water-regime context

sciml_fruit_growth.purpose: Neural ODE/UDE examples with irregular individual trajectories

sciml_fertility_dynamic.purpose: UDE missing-physics examples for mineral N, plant N and biomass

sciml_irrigation_horizon.purpose: dynamic design and bounded control examples
